node.title: WCL ell=4 weight-9 quartic-divisor descent
node.statement: Every reduced signed weight-9 relation at an exact order-2048 root with vanishing first four odd moments has a unique common-dilation normalization whose locator is F(X)=X A(X^2)-1 for a monic quartic A, and it exists exactly when G(Y)=Y A(Y)^2-1 divides Y^1024-1. The nine remainder coefficients form a four-variable integer ideal with no characteristic-zero point, so one nonzero integer Nullstellensatz certificate restricts every survivor to finitely many characteristics. No such certificate or official exclusion is claimed.
